BiblicalUsage: tsinnûwr is the word the Bible uses when it means a culvert, a water-channel. In 2 Samuel 5:8, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and it appears again in Psalms 42:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the water-channel David's men climbed tells me God opens unlikely ways into walled cities.
